name: mock-ssc-portal-server
description: Phase 3 — the minimal server-side bridge for the standalone mock SSC portal (GovRecruit-A). Holds this government client's secret and is the ONLY thing that ever authenticates to OTR-India's government-client-authenticated endpoints; the mock-ssc-portal browser bundle never sees this secret. A genuinely separate process/origin from both OTR's backend and this portal's own frontend build.
